utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I'll see what I can rustle up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that's perfect, Bo! I knew I could count on you. Tell everyone you see about the drive!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do, Quinn. I'll spread the word while grabbing those supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right, the repair drive. Saturday. Community center. I think I have a wrench somewhere in my garage—barely ever use it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's perfect! I was wondering if I could bring my old toaster to the drive—think you could take a look at it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, a toaster? I'm not much of an appliance guy, but I can take a look. No promises though.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, everyone. What's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We're set for Saturday morning, just like always. You and I are on the early shift, so we'll have it running smooth by noon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I've got my tools ready. Let's make sure we start on time this week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the old playground—it's really coming together!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Vik, that's actually been moved! It's now happening on Sunday at the community center instead. Spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, Sunday at the community center? Got it, I'll make sure everyone knows the plan changed!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I just grabbed some extra tools from the hardware store for the repair drive. Want to help me sort them out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help. I know we need them for Saturday's drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, let's spread them out on my porch and see what we've got.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, so we just need to make sure the repair crew knows to wrap up by 2:30 to give us a buffer before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, repair crew? I thought we were talking about fixing old toasters... Is that the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh no, not toasters — we're getting the playground equipment fixed before the kids get out of school.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! I was just talking to Opal about the repair drive—she found the part we need in the supply shed. Want to help us haul stuff on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great to hear Opal found the part! Which repair drive is this for—the water pump or the backup generator?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's for the water pump! Sam's organizing a big haul this Saturday, and I could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning, my garage. Bring the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, the water pump drive. Do you have a replacement part in your garage, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, but I can check if yours can be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're saying we actually fixed what needed fixing? No surprises?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, no hiccups this time. But I want to double-check—are we still meeting Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, Sunday's still on. But are you absolutely sure that repair drive is solid? I don't want any last-minute surprises.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope we have enough volunteers to manage the pickup and drop-off spots smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, don't you worry, Pia! I've been chatting up everyone I see, and Oren and Gus are both planning to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief! I was worried we'd be short-handed for the morning shift especially.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I heard about it from Vik and Quinn. Sounds like a great idea—I already told Ira I'd help organize the tools at Leo's garage.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Sam! I'm glad you're on board. I'll be at Leo's garage early Saturday to help sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Mara! I'll be there too—let's make sure everything's ready before the others arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I've been meaning to ask about that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I've been buried in the supply list, but it's coming together. You planning to join us?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'd like to, but I'm not sure I can swing it right now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I'm glad you asked! The repair drive is this Saturday—we're fixing up the park benches and the old playground. Quinn mentioned they need all the help they can get, and Ira's even bringing extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're telling me that repair drive is actually going to hold up? No hidden issues?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Honestly, Kira, things look solid this time. I've seen the plans and everyone's been showing up with supplies—no reason it shouldn't go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Ira, just a heads up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa! I'll make sure to bring those supplies to the community center on Sunday then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I really appreciate that, Ira! We could use all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Uli, yes! Pia and I were just talking about that—if we start at 9, we should be clear by pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, sounds like a solid plan! I'll be there hauling stuff, so let me know if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that would be wonderful, Jules! More hands definitely help—maybe you could help wrangle the kids who want to 'help' too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got the supply list almost done—just need to double-check we have enough nails and wood for the playground benches.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good, Cleo, but I'm still worried about how we'll manage the crowd if everyone shows up at once—maybe we should set specific time slots for drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Time slots are a great idea, Pia—I'll mark them on the supply checklist so we can track when materials come in and avoid a bottleneck.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, everyone. What's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Right, fixing toasters and... wait, is it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Oren. But yes, it's this Saturday—Noah just mentioned he's bringing his toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the drive. I'll grab the duct tape and hammers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Bo, you're grabbing the duct tape and hammers? That's perfect—Dane and Quinn said we need those for the park benches at the drive this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, this Saturday? I thought you said next Saturday—I might've mixed up the date.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Hana, just a heads-up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at my porch. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, thanks for the update, Gus. So it's Sunday at the community center now? Does that still work for the water pump repair, and will the wrench I checked still fit those bolt sizes?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, Sunday at the community center works fine, and that wrench should still fit—I'll have some backup sizes just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I have a flyer if you want one—it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 to 4, that works for me. I'll be there right at 10, tools in hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I'll bring my old toaster and see what we can do with it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, this Saturday? I thought that was next month. I don’t have my wrench handy, but I could probably find it by then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, no, it's definitely this Saturday! I double-checked with Vik, so don't worry — you've got a few days to rustle up that wrench.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, okay, this Saturday then. I'll dig through my garage tonight and see if I can find that wrench.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We're starting Saturday morning at 8, like always—Eli's already confirmed that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I'll be there—I've got some time that morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Uli. Do you know if the hardware store on Maple has the right valve size, or should I check the one on Oak?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So we're meeting Sunday at the community center now, right? Just to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, Saturday morning at my garage. Bring the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought we changed it to Sunday at the community center. Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Nell, I'm really excited about the repair drive this Saturday! We're going to get that old playground looking great again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Mara, that sounds wonderful! I was hoping to bring my old toaster by—do you think they'd have time for little fixes like that too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Nell! We're setting up a general repair station too, so bring that toaster by and we'll have someone take a look at it.
